venues.trending_copy: Paddock Bakery runs out of a restored weatherboard cottage in Miami, and the picket-fence courtyard is doing as much work as the pastry counter. Get a croissant out the back before 9am; the courtyard tables go well before the morning does.
venues.must_try: Croissants, rustic sourdough, seasonal pastries, specialty coffee in the courtyard

venues.trending_copy: Bam Bam's Nutella choux bombs are the reason Mermaid Beach forms a queue, and the regulars will tell you they're non-negotiable. The nasi goreng breakfast is the sleeper order — proof the kitchen isn't only here for the pastry counter.
venues.must_try: Jalapeño & queso fresco sweetcorn fritters, nasi goreng breakfast, Nutella choux bombs (non-negotiable), pastries & dessert pots

venues.trending_copy: Tarte turned a pared-back white room and an exclusive Parallel Roasters blend into the Burleigh template everyone else now borrows. Come for the house coffee, stay for whatever's just landed in the pastry cabinet.
venues.must_try: Parallel Roasters house blend, breakfast burrito, nourish bowl, fresh-baked pastries

venues.trending_copy: Palm Springs leans all the way into its name — pastel walls, desert-oasis styling, the kind of corner that fills a camera roll before the coffee lands. The look does the heavy lifting, but the brunch holds its own once you've got the photo.
venues.must_try: Specialty coffee, brunch plates, the pastel courtyard for a slow morning

venues.trending_copy: Paradox built its new Broadbeach flagship around an oval coffee bar and a batch-brew tap, then started pouring lattes that taste like dessert — lychee pavlova, strawberry brownie. Order something off the creative list; the daily flat white is good, but it's not why people are here.
venues.must_try: Lychee pavlova latte, strawberry brownie latte, batch-brew off the tap, frozen V60

venues.trending_copy: Sun Devil hides inside Strange Days, a Coolangatta vintage store, and commits fully to the Americana fever-dream — chrome, neon, coffee poured among the racks. You come for the novelty and end up staying because the coffee's genuinely sharp.
venues.must_try: Espresso among the vinyl, filter coffee, and the browse-while-you-wait vintage racks

venues.trending_copy: LOAF took over the old Mylk Well site at Palm Beach and kept it simple — acai, avo, a grab-and-go window, and sand within a few steps. The move is the weekend-only tiramisu iced latte; locals time their Saturdays around it.
venues.must_try: Weekend tiramisu iced latte, acai bowls, avo toast, grab-and-go for the beach

venues.trending_copy: Hazel runs an Australia-meets-Southeast-Asia menu out of Southport, which is a long way of saying the Vietnamese coffee is the order. Get the sea-salt cream version; it's the one regulars come back across town for.
venues.must_try: Sea-salt cream Vietnamese coffee, Australia-meets-Southeast-Asia brunch plates

venues.trending_copy: Bear Boy is the reason northern-end locals stopped driving south for a decent coffee — terracotta everywhere, Single O in the cup, and a menu that puns on bears harder than it strictly needs to. The Big Bear Benny on a hash waffle is the one to beat.
venues.must_try: Big Bear Benny on a hash waffle, Single O coffee, blueberry white-chocolate pancakes
